additional_info.subject: RE: ID0422065-DC/Si-D/DE-[ Y2 / S7 313808292002 ]  Charger does not go online CRM:02684000189
additional_info.body:
Dear Eduard Huber - TankE GmbH,
We have checked the charger on SCB and found that it is currently offline. Unfortunately, we are unable to perform any further actions remotely without an active SCB connection.
As a next step, I recommend performing a hard reset via the OCPP server if the charger is connected on OCPP. If a remote reset from OCPP is not possible, a local reboot will be necessary to bring the charger back online.
If the charger remains offline after these actions, we will need to plan a site visit to inspect the router settings and check the network signal strength.
Please let us know if further assistance is required.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
